non_claim_boundary: This is a public rate-card v2 contract, not a published public rate card, statutory-rate proposal, tax proposal, effective-rate publication, savings estimate, waste finding, fraud finding, department-cut instruction, technology-savings claim, or balanced-budget claim. Not calculated and blocked are first-class public outcomes.

card_status_values.meaning: The field is intentionally null because prerequisite evidence or model work has not been completed.
The field remains null or false because a named gate failed or is incomplete.
An internal calculation may exist, but publication gates have not passed.
The card may publish only after rate-publication, role-review, and public-language gates pass.

statutory_language_rule: Avoid statutory-rate language unless the rate-publication gate, role review, public-language review, assigned-base model, incidence model, distribution model, behavior model, administration model, and interaction scoring all pass.

display_rules.missing_values_rule: Missing values remain null and blocked gates remain false; public cards must display not calculated or blocked instead of filling a zero.
display_rules.denominator_boundary: All-receipt funding share and residual general-fund requirement share must be labeled separately. A residual share is not share of every tax dollar.
display_rules.risk_language_boundary: Overspending-risk classifications must not be described as waste, fraud, recoverable savings, causal savings, budget savings, or a department cut unless separate positive evidence and publication gates pass.
display_rules.technology_language_boundary: Technology-transition status must not be described as savings, a target-cost reduction, a lower rate, or a department cut unless transition-cost, measured-productivity, stress, score-provenance, and outcome-floor gates pass.
